findings.title: Failed diagnostic fallback output replaces the original gate exit
findings.reproducer: Execute the exact extracted workflow bash block with inert docker returning 0 and inert make printing one public line then exiting 7; leave real GNU tee/mktemp in place and connect workflow stdout to /dev/full. tee --output-error=warn drains and returns nonzero, then the capture-failure printf fails under set -e: actual workflow exit is 1, not 7. Also reproduced with make emitting no stdout and exiting 7, reporter stub exiting 9, and stdout=/dev/full: the reporter-failed fallback printf similarly replaces exit 7 with 1.
findings.criterion: The original nonzero gate status must survive tee/reporter failures. The saved PIPESTATUS is correct, but the workflow can abort before its final exit gate_status.
findings.minimal_fix: Make the two fallback annotation printf commands best-effort with || : (or equivalent), preserving the already saved statuses. No reporter/parser or producer change is needed. Add one narrowly scoped failing-output control to the existing extracted-workflow tests.
findings.verification: Same extracted shell with only the two || : additions made in memory preserves exit 7 in both cases; repository bytes were not edited.
findings.impact_boundary: Requires failure of the public stdout sink as well as the error-reporting path. Does not produce false GREEN; job still fails. Ordinary capture-file errors and reporter errors with healthy stdout already preserve the exit.

accepted_observations: Makefile:19-20 selects unchanged canonical runner --check; default target is check-components. Producer uses resolved TMPDIR/db-16hex, root 0700, gate.log 0600, and flushes exact CANONICAL_GATE_BEGIN target=check-components log=... to stdout at ops/run_test_db_gate.py:983. Private component stdout/stderr goes to gate.log, not outer stdout.

Workflow explicitly selects bash, uses private mktemp capture, streams stdout via tee --output-error=warn, and saves PIPESTATUS before any clobbering command. Reader opens only the captured exact canonical locator; no directory scan/latest selection or unrelated DB lookup remains.

Independent readback of retained of1 root found 154 entries and canonical DB at index 101. Historical failed/passed outer logs are 1045/1008 bytes, each with exactly one conforming canonical locator, comfortably within 64 KiB. These were only read, never executed.

All 15 existing focused SOURCE controls passed on the current freeze, including 154 decoys plus 8 unrelated DB logs, original exit 7, success 0 without reporter, capture/reporter errors, and missing/duplicate/foreign/truncated/invalid locators.

Independent real GNU tee failure against an owned directory preserved original gate 7 and converted healthy 0 to nonzero 1. Public output was observed before the fake make exited; output after the pause remained visible. This supplements mocked-tee tests with actual tee streaming/error behavior.

Independent inert pytest 9.1.1 calibration used a byte-copy of the real api/pyproject.toml and the normal Makefile test-api argv/path form, with -B added solely to prohibit bytecode writes. Actual failure used api/tests/test_health.py:5 and FAILED api/tests/test_health.py::test_live_rejects_a_foreign_host[param]. Feeding this real output through the extracted workflow with large scratch layout produced the source-validated selector/frame, preserved gate exit 7, and omitted the synthetic parameter/message value.

Read-only parsing of the retained failed gate yielded the expected unittest selector, known source locations, UnsafeFixture class and check-development target. No raw private log or private values were printed. The previous remote failure's underlying test remains UNKNOWN.
